business_summary: EIT Environmental Development Group Co.,Ltd provides urban integrated operation and management services. It provides building cleaning, property management, urban greening management, domestic waste treatment equipment manufacturing, and termite prevention services; vector, forestry pest, indoor air pollution, and atmospheric environmental pollution control services; landscaping project construction; environmental protection equipment manufacturing; environmental protection equipment sales; flower planting; flower and green plant rental and management; machinery and equipment rental; and machinery and equipment sales services. The company also engages in leasing services; sale of new energy vehicles; car sales; small and micro passenger car leasing and operating services; professional cleaning, washing, and disinfection services; water pollution control; environmental sanitation public facilities installation; market management; municipal facilities management; sewage treatment and recycling; solid waste management; recycling of renewable resources; parking lot, housekeeping, and labor services; research and development of technology for harmless resource utilization of agricultural and forestry wastes; research and development of resource recycling technology; wholesale of clothing and accessories, kitchenware, sanitary ware, daily necessities, hardware products; retail of clothing and accessories; retail of hardware products; information consulting services; repair and maintenance of motor vehicles; and sale of plastic and labor protection products and daily necessities. In addition, it is involved in urban domestic waste business; restaurant kitchen waste treatment; indoor environment testing; construction project construction; road freight transport; hazardous waste management; Internet information services; and tap water production and supply activities. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
